name: August Pfluger
page_title: August Pfluger's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (TX) - District 11

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Today, SCOTUS hears the most critical abortion-case since Roe v. Wade 50 years ago. I’m at SCOTUS with those speaking up for life. Our Nation has allowed abortions to go on for 50 years - 50 years of lives abandoned. I urge SCOTUS to make the right decision and defend LIFE."
"Overturning Roe is a momentous decision for LIFE."
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee

"I will always stand for life and speak up for the unborn. The #Dobbs case that #SCOTUS is deliberating this week could overturn Roe v. Wade—the tragic decision that has ended over 62 million lives over the last 50 years in the USA"

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Limit, Save, Grow fixes the national debt crisis, saves nearly $5 trillion over ten years, puts an end to government programs being against our own citizens, and puts people back to work—all while protecting Medicare and Social Security and restoring American energy dominance. It's time for President Biden to come to the table and negotiate."
Rated 0% by Alliance for Retired Americans

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "Build Back Bankrupt will cripple our economy and force hard-working Americans to lend their tax dollars to the Democrat’s socialist agenda."

"I am wholly opposed to @POTUS' exorbitant $6 trillion budget that weakens our hand against China and will harm our economy, small businesses, and rural America. We cannot pursue policies that will raise taxes, skyrocket inflation, and lower paychecks for American families."
"Taxpayer-funded abortions, IRS surveillance, and tax hikes on all Americans are wrong no matter the price tag."
Rated 80% by Freedom Works

evidence.text: Rated 79% by National Taxpayers Union

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "I'm particularly disturbed by the fact that if this bill passes, taxpayer dollars will be directly funneled to congressional candidates and campaigns," Pfluger said. "The folks in my district ... absolutely do not approve of their hard-earned dollars paying for TV attack ads of any candidate, much less candidates they don't support."
Rated 6% by Common Cause
Voted Against HR 1 "For the People Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "Democrat soft-on-crime policies are making our communities less safe. House Republicans have a #CommitmentToAmerica to reverse rising crime rates and return to law and order. We will hire more officers and oppose all efforts to defund the police. #BackTheBlue"

"Democrats voted to defund our police, once again writing off common-sense solutions that keep Americans safe & support the men and women in law enforcement who selflessly serve our communities every day. Our law enforcement deserve better. #BackTheBlue"
Voted against HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "Defending our borders and our national security interests requires military dominance and the political will to utilize that dominance."

"The National Defense bill is PASSED. Proud to vote for this measure that strips the military vaccine mandate, blocks poison pills, and refocuses our military on maintaining its status as the most lethal fighting force in the world."
Voted in favor of HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted in favor of HR 4365: "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2024"

"Build Back Bankrupt will cripple our economy and force hard-working Americans to lend their tax dollars to the Democrat’s socialist agenda."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 8294 "Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2023"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "I am an easy NO vote on Speaker Pelosi's final hoorah—a $1.8 TRILLION, 4,000-page spending spree that will make inflation worse while doing nothing to fix the border and drug crisis plaguing our country."
"President Biden just claimed the answer to inflation is passing more inflation-causing spending bills. No."

"Today is the one-year anniversary of the ARP/BBB being signed into law. This bill caused soaring inflation, paid to keep workers on the sidelines, spent more than $500 billion to keep businesses/schools in lockdown, and has hurt the health of everyday Americans and our economy."

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "SCOTUS rules President Biden’s $400 billion student loan bailout scheme is unconstitutional. Hard-working Americans will not be burdened with increased taxes to pay the bills for those who willingly took on—and have yet to pay off—debt."

"Transferring debt for student loans is a slap in the face of every student and family who budgeted, saved, chose an affordable university, deferred their education, and/or worked through college. Loans are not "forgiven." They will be paid for by you, the American taxpayer."

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "80% of Americans support voter ID requirements. Pass it on."

"Supporting voter ID or opposing the Democrats' election power-grab does not make you George Wallace or Jefferson Davis. Democrats are trying to distract from the real crises we are facing under their watch. The American people aren't buying it."

"Tonight, Dems are twisting the rules to nationalize our election system with a bill that sends hard-earned taxpayer dollars to finance political campaigns, requires states to allow felons to vote, and overrides wildly-popular voter ID laws."
Rated 6% by Common Cause

"I support President Trump’s vision for securing America and believe we must secure our southern border to protect our citizens from dangerous drug cartels, human traffickers, and illegal immigrants."

positions.question: Do you support economic intervention as a means of resolving international conflicts?

evidence.text: "During his time in Congress, Pfluger has held several press conferences with leaders like Secretary Mike Pompeo to call on President Biden to impose sanctions on Iran, as well as with Texas Senator John Cornyn, Republican Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy and Representative Michael McCaul, to call for the release of U.S. Marine Veteran Trevor Reed from a Russian prison."

"Putin is testing American resolve, and our allies and partners around the world are watching. The Biden Admin must take strong and decisive action to deter Russia through sanctions and lethal assistance to Ukraine."

"The House just PASSED my amendment to the No Funds for Iranian Terrorism Act to freeze all sanctioned Iranian assets permanently. This is the strongest sanctions bill against Iran ever to pass the House. The U.S. should not be funding terrorism."
